recommended_fixes.fix: Add explicit warning in parallel-branch section: 'Do NOT branch off the same checkout for parallel work — each branch must get its own worktree.' Add merge check to cleanup guide: 'git branch --merged main | grep <branch>' before git worktree remove.
Change codex cursor_bugbot_trigger from 'false' to 'conditional # gh pr comment available when gh is installed'. Add fallback: 'gh pr comment <N> --body @cursor @bugbot review'.
